method: Compile and execute entire exact production C# pressure-hatch, walking-gate, geometry-builder, authored-shell validator and original-door adapter sources with deterministic dependency doubles. Exercises custom state, geometry generation and physical-connection checks; native Open semantics reduced to documented branches. Mirrors the evidenced KSPCF forced-convex assignment before imported-shell validation without executing the actual parser.

scope_limitations: Dependency doubles do not execute Unity/PhysX collision, shader rendering, KSP asset loading, ModuleManager, or actual native FreeIVA connection discovery/coroutines.
The forced-convex regression mirrors the single assignment evidenced in the actual KSPCF 1.41.1 parser source; the native parser itself is not executed by this harness.
Simulated scoped-wrapper/no-reparent/renderer-variant conditions do not prove which loader state occurred in a particular KSP session.
Production sources are also compiled separately against actual KSP/Unity/FreeIVA API references by build.sh.
mesh_cutter_dependency_double: Any native MeshCutter create/cut request deliberately throws; these checks exercise lifecycle/readiness and no-cut shell generation only.
